independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: الاستقلال 1 يناير 1956 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 43)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: The Sudan gained independence from British-Egyptian rule on 1 January 1956.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: The role of Islam in Sudan, and Sudan's identification as an Arab or African state, are questions that have been open since independence in 1956.

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: Sudan reached independence without an agreed permanent constitution. The Constituent Assembly adopted a Transitional Constitution, replacing the governor general as head of state with a five-member Supreme Commission. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: نال السودان استقلاله دون اتفاق على دستور دائم. واعتمدت الجمعية التأسيسية دستوراً انتقالياً استُبدل بموجبه الحاكم العام بمجلس سيادة من خمسة أعضاء. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: the Constituent Assembly adopted a document known as the Transitional Constitution, which replaced the governor general as head of state with a five-member Supreme Commission

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: In June 1956 Khatmiyyah members who had left the NUP founded the People's Democratic Party (PDP) under Mirghani's leadership. The PDP later combined with the Umma in parliament to bring down Azhari's government. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: في يونيو 1956 أسس أعضاء من الختمية انشقوا عن الحزب الوطني الاتحادي حزب الشعب الديمقراطي بقيادة الميرغني، ثم تحالف مع حزب الأمة في البرلمان لإسقاط حكومة الأزهري. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: In June some Khatmiyyah members who had defected from the NUP established the People's Democratic Party (PDP) under Mirghani's leadership.

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: In March 1958 Prime Minister Abd Allah Khalil signed a technical assistance agreement with the United States. The NUP tried to use the pact to defeat the coalition, but parliament approved it with Umma, some PDP and southern votes. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: في مارس 1958 وقّع رئيس الوزراء عبد الله خليل اتفاقية مساعدة فنية مع الولايات المتحدة، وأقرها البرلمان رغم معارضة الاتحاديين وبعض نواب حزب الشعب. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: In March 1958, Khalil signed a technical assistance agreement with the United States.

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: The 1958 elections gave the Umma a plurality in both houses and the Umma-PDP coalition an overall majority. In the south, voters backed advocates of autonomy within a federal system. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: منحت انتخابات 1958 حزب الأمة أكثرية في المجلسين وتحالف الأمة والشعب أغلبية إجمالية، بينما صوّت الجنوب لصالح دعاة الحكم الذاتي في إطار فيدرالي. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: The electorate gave a plurality in both houses to the Umma and an overall majority to the Umma-PDP coalition.

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: A poor cotton harvest after the 1957 bumper crop depleted reserves, and import restrictions plus an Egyptian embargo on Sudanese cattle, camels and dates hit town and country. Growing discontent brought many antigovernment demonstrations in Khartoum. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: أدى ضعف محصول القطن بعد موسم 1957 الوفير إلى استنزاف الاحتياطيات، وزادت قيود الاستيراد والحظر المصري على الماشية والإبل والتمور السودانية من السخط، فخرجت مظاهرات عديدة مناهضة للحكومة في الخرطوم. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: Growing popular discontent caused many antigovernment demonstrations in Khartoum.

independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.en: On 17 November 1958, the day parliament was to convene, a military coup took place. Khalil planned it with Umma leaders and generals Ibrahim Abbud and Ahmad Abd al Wahab, who became leaders of the military regime. (LOC1991_INDSUDAN HTML page, no page numbers)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: في 17 نوفمبر 1958، يوم انعقاد البرلمان، وقع انقلاب عسكري خطط له عبد الله خليل مع قادة من حزب الأمة والفريقين إبراهيم عبود وأحمد عبد الوهاب. [يحتاج تحقق]
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: On November 17, 1958, the day parliament was to convene, a military coup occurred.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: May 1969: officers led by Colonel Nimeiri take power (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: مايو 1969: ضباط بقيادة العقيد نميري يستولون على السلطة [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: ...in May 1969 a group of officers led by Colonel Gaafar Mohamed Al-Nimeiri took power.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14

also.quote: ...or the 1983 attempt of the Nimeiri military dictatorship (1969-85)--to apply Islamic law, or shar'ia , to the south.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: Addis Ababa Agreement, February 1972 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: اتفاقية أديس أبابا فبراير 1972 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: In February 1972 Nimeiri signed the so-called Addis Ababa agreement with rebels from the south, which provided for a kind of autonomy for the south. This agreement made peace possible for the next 11 years.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: The conflict was punctuated by an autonomy agreement in 1972 that ended the first civil war between southern separatist forces and the central government, then headed by President Jaafar Nimieri, a military dictator.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: September 1983 Shariah rule; second war with the south begins 1983 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: تطبيق الشريعة سبتمبر 1983؛ بدء الحرب الثانية مع الجنوب 1983 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: ...in September 1983 ... Nimeiri introduced Shariah rule. All of these steps led to strong reactions in the south, and eventually to the start of the second war with the south in 1983.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14; Glossary

also.quote: ...or the 1983 attempt of the Nimeiri military dictatorship (1969-85)--to apply Islamic law, or shar'ia , to the south. | Glossary: Anya-Nya II rebel south Sudanese forces who, together with former members of the Sudanese army, formed the SPLA in 1983

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: April 1985: Nimeiri government overthrown (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: أبريل 1985: الإطاحة بحكومة نميري [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: Finally, in April 1985, after 16 years in power, the military Government of Nimeiri was overthrown in a military coup organized by army officers

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: Popular movements, engaging in strikes and street demonstrations, almost without bloodshed overthrew two military governments in 1969 and 1985.

cite_extra.caveat: Source sentence says '1969 and 1985'; only 1985 is used here. Historian review advised.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: On taking power the Revolutionary Command Council suspended the Transitional Constitution, abolished government institutions and banned political parties. It also nationalized many industries, businesses and banks. (LOC1991_NIMEIRI HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: علّق مجلس قيادة الثورة الدستور الانتقالي وألغى المؤسسات الحكومية وحظر الأحزاب، وأمم كثيراً من الصناعات والشركات والمصارف. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: The RCC also nationalized many industries, businesses, and banks.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: In March 1970 fighting broke out between government forces and the Ansar on Aba Island, and the army assaulted the island with air support. Imam Al Hadi al Mahdi was killed while trying to cross into Ethiopia. (LOC1991_NIMEIRI HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: في مارس 1970 اندلع القتال بين القوات الحكومية والأنصار في الجزيرة أبا، وهاجمها الجيش بغطاء جوي، وقُتل الإمام الهادي المهدي أثناء محاولته العبور إلى إثيوبيا. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: When the Ansar ignored an ultimatum to surrender, army units with air support assaulted Aba Island.

toll.quote: About 3,000 people died during the battle.
toll.note: verbatim quote from the cited source; no min/max figures

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: On 19 July 1971 Major Hisham al Atta seized Nimeiri and the RCC in a communist-backed coup. Loyal units rescued Nimeiri three days later, and hundreds of communists and dissident officers were arrested, some executed. (LOC1991_NIMEIRI HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: في 19 يوليو 1971 احتجز الرائد هاشم العطا نميري ومجلس قيادة الثورة في انقلاب مدعوم من الشيوعيين، واستعادت وحدات موالية السيطرة بعد ثلاثة أيام. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: The coup occurred on July 19, 1971, when one of the plotters, Major Hisham al Atta, surprised Nimeiri and the RCC meeting in the presidential palace

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: A provisional constitution published in August 1971 described Sudan as a socialist democracy with a presidential system replacing the RCC. A plebiscite the following month elected Nimeiri to a six-year term. (LOC1991_NIMEIRI HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: وصف دستور مؤقت صدر في أغسطس 1971 السودان بأنه ديمقراطية اشتراكية، وانتُخب نميري في استفتاء لولاية مدتها ست سنوات. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: A plebiscite the following month elected Nimeiri to a six-year term as president.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: After the 1976 coup attempt, Nimeiri and Sadiq al Mahdi signed an eight-point 'national reconciliation' agreement at Port Sudan. It readmitted the opposition to national life, restored civil liberties and freed political prisoners. (LOC1991_RECONCIL HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: بعد محاولة انقلاب 1976 وقّع نميري والصادق المهدي في بورتسودان اتفاق 'المصالحة الوطنية' ذا النقاط الثماني. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: the two leaders signed an eight-point agreement that readmitted the opposition to national life in return for the dissolution of the National Front.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: On 5 June 1983 Nimeiri redivided the Southern Region into the three old provinces of Bahr al Ghazal, Al Istiwai and Aali an Nil. The SPLM and SPLA, which emerged in mid-1983, opposed the redivision. (LOC1991_RECONCIL HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: في 5 يونيو 1983 أعاد نميري تقسيم الإقليم الجنوبي إلى المديريات الثلاث القديمة، وعارضت الحركة الشعبية والجيش الشعبي ذلك. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: On June 5, 1983, Nimeiri sought to counter the south's growing political power by redividing the Southern Region into the three old provinces

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: In early 1985 a general strike in Khartoum against rising food, gasoline and transport costs paralyzed the country. Nimeiri, visiting the United States, could not suppress the growing demonstrations. (LOC1991_RECONCIL HTML page, no page numbers)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: في مطلع 1985 شلّ إضراب عام في الخرطوم احتجاجاً على ارتفاع أسعار الغذاء والوقود والنقل البلاد. [يحتاج تحقق]
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: Demonstrators opposed rising food, gasoline, and transport costs.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Transitional Military Council under General Siwar Al-Dahab (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: المجلس العسكري الانتقالي بقيادة الفريق سوار الذهب [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: ...a Transitional Military Council was put in place under the leadership of General Abed Rahman Siwar Al-Dahab.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Elections 1986; Sadiq Al-Mahdi Prime Minister (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: انتخابات 1986؛ الصادق المهدي رئيسًا للوزراء [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: Elections were organized in 1986, which led to the victory of the Umma party’s leader, Sadiq Al-Mahdi, who became Prime Minister.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14

also.quote: ...whether the present one, the prior democratic one (1986-89), or the 1983 attempt...

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: On 6 April 1985 officers led by Lt Gen Abd ar Rahman Siwar adh Dhahab overthrew Nimeiri. Three days later a fifteen-man Transitional Military Council was created, which suspended the constitution and dissolved the SSU. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: في 6 أبريل 1985 أطاح ضباط بقيادة الفريق عبد الرحمن سوار الذهب بنميري، وتشكل بعد ثلاثة أيام مجلس عسكري انتقالي من خمسة عشر عضواً. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: On April 6, 1985, a group of military officers, led by Lieutenant General Abd ar Rahman Siwar adh Dhahab, overthrew Nimeiri, who took refuge in Egypt.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: In late April 1985 talks between the TMC and the Alliance of Professional and Trade Unions set up a civilian cabinet under Dr. Gazuli Dafalla, subordinate to the TMC. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: في أواخر أبريل 1985 أسفرت مفاوضات المجلس العسكري والتجمع النقابي عن حكومة مدنية برئاسة الجزولي دفع الله. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: negotiations between the TMC and the Alliance of Professional and Trade Unions resulted in the establishment of a civilian cabinet under the direction of Dr. Gazuli Dafalla.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Famine threatened vast areas of southern and western Sudan. Despite appeals to forty donor and relief agencies, the TMC could not prevent heavy loss of life. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: هددت المجاعة مناطق واسعة في جنوب السودان وغربه، ولم يتمكن المجلس العسكري من منع خسائر فادحة في الأرواح رغم مناشدة أربعين جهة مانحة. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: Moreover, famine threatened vast areas of southern and western Sudan.

toll.quote: Dhahab was unable to prevent famine from claiming an estimated 400,000 to 500,000 lives.
toll.note: verbatim quote from the cited source; no min/max figures

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: In February 1986 the IMF declared Sudan bankrupt after the TMC refused IMF austerity measures. Sudan's international debt was about US$9 billion when Dhahab took power. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: في فبراير 1986 أعلن صندوق النقد الدولي إفلاس السودان بعد رفض المجلس العسكري إجراءات التقشف. [يحتاج تحقق]

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: In March 1986 the government and the SPLM produced the Koka Dam Declaration, calling for a Sudan free of racism and discrimination. It demanded repeal of the sharia and a constitutional conference; the DUP and NIF did not support it. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: في مارس 1986 أصدرت الحكومة والحركة الشعبية إعلان كوكادام الداعي إلى سودان خالٍ من العنصرية وإلى إلغاء قوانين الشريعة وعقد مؤتمر دستوري. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: In March 1986, the Sudanese government and the SPLM produced the Koka Dam Declaration

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: The April 1986 general election was spread over twelve days and postponed in thirty-seven southern constituencies. The Umma won ninety-nine seats, the DUP sixty-four and the NIF fifty-one. (LOC1991_TMC HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: جرت انتخابات أبريل 1986 على مدى اثني عشر يوماً وأُجلت في 37 دائرة جنوبية، وفاز حزب الأمة بـ99 مقعداً والاتحادي بـ64 والجبهة الإسلامية بـ51. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: The Umma Party, headed by Sadiq al Mahdi, won ninety-nine seats.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: In November 1988 DUP leader Mirghani and the SPLM signed an agreement in Addis Ababa providing for a cease-fire, a freeze of the sharia and a constitutional conference. When the government refused to support it, the DUP left the coalition. (LOC1991_SADIQ HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: في نوفمبر 1988 وقّع الميرغني والحركة الشعبية اتفاقاً في أديس أبابا نص على وقف إطلاق النار وتجميد قوانين الشريعة، وانسحب الاتحادي من الائتلاف بعد رفض الحكومة له. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: In November 1988, another more explosive political issue emerged when Mirghani and the SPLM signed an agreement in Addis Ababa

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Army commander Lt Gen Fathi Ahmad Ali delivered an ultimatum signed by 150 senior officers demanding a more representative government and terms to end the war. Sadiq al Mahdi dissolved the government on 11 March 1989. (LOC1991_SADIQ HTML page, no page numbers)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: قدم القائد العام الفريق فتحي أحمد علي مذكرة موقعة من 150 ضابطاً، فحل الصادق المهدي الحكومة في 11 مارس 1989. [يحتاج تحقق]
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: On March 11, 1989, Sadiq al Mahdi responded to this pressure by dissolving the government.

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: Darfur conflict: incidents from February 2003; ICC arrest warrant for President al-Bashir, 4 March 2009 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.2)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: نزاع دارفور منذ فبراير 2003؛ مذكرة توقيف من المحكمة الجنائية الدولية بحق البشير 4 مارس 2009 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.2)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: ...it focused in particular on incidents that occurred from February 2003

cite_extra.quote: 4 March 2009 ... The International Criminal Court (ICC) today issued an arrest warrant for war crimes and crimes against humanity committed in the strife-torn Darfur region by Sudanese President Omar Al-Bashir, the first sitting Head of State to be indicted by the Court.

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: Sudan–South Sudan Cooperation Agreements signed 27 September 2012 in Addis Ababa (UNSC2075 p.1, preamble)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: توقيع اتفاقيات التعاون بين السودان وجنوب السودان في 27 سبتمبر 2012 بأديس أبابا [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: 27 September Agreements on Cooperation and Security Arrangements reached by the Government of Sudan and the Government of South Sudan in Addis Ababa under the auspices of the AU High-Level Implementation Panel (AUHIP)

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: On 24 March 2005 the Security Council welcomed the Comprehensive Peace Agreement and established the UN Mission in Sudan (UNMIS). It was authorized with up to 10,000 military personnel. (UNSC1590 p.2, op.1)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: في 24 مارس 2005 رحب مجلس الأمن باتفاق السلام الشامل وأنشأ بعثة الأمم المتحدة في السودان (يونميس). [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: Decides to establish the United Nations Mission in Sudan (UNMIS) for an initial period of 6 months

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: On 27 June 2011 the Security Council created the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA). It followed the 20 June 2011 Addis Ababa agreement on temporary arrangements for the Abyei Area. (UNSC1990 p.2, op.1)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: في 27 يونيو 2011 أنشأ مجلس الأمن قوة الأمم المتحدة الأمنية المؤقتة لأبيي (يونيسفا) عقب اتفاق أديس أبابا في 20 يونيو 2011. [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: Decides to establish, for a period of 6 months, the United Nations Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA)

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: After South Sudan's secession, fighting between the Sudanese armed forces and SPLM/North continued in Southern Kordofan and Blue Nile. The UN reported refugees arriving daily from Southern Kordofan into South Sudan. (UNSG_S2012_877 PDF p.10-11, paras 41, 46)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: بعد انفصال جنوب السودان استمر القتال بين القوات المسلحة والحركة الشعبية-شمال في جنوب كردفان والنيل الأزرق، وأفادت الأمم المتحدة بتدفق لاجئين يومياً. [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: The fighting in Southern Kordofan and Blue Nile States between the Sudanese armed forces and SPLM/North continued throughout the reporting period

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: On 12 April 2012 the Security Council expressed alarm at the seizure of Heglig and its oil fields in Sudan by the SPLA. It demanded SPLA withdrawal and an end to SAF aerial bombardments. (UNSC_PRST_2012_12 p.1)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: في 12 أبريل 2012 أعرب مجلس الأمن عن قلقه من استيلاء الجيش الشعبي على هجليج وحقولها النفطية، وطالب بانسحابه ووقف القصف الجوي. [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: the seizure and occupation of the town of Heglig and its oil fields in Sudan by the SPLA

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: Resolution 2046 ordered Sudan and South Sudan to cease all hostilities immediately, including aerial bombardments. It required them to resume AUHIP-led negotiations within two weeks. (UNSC2046 PDF p.3, op.1)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: ألزم القرار 2046 السودان وجنوب السودان بوقف جميع الأعمال العدائية فوراً واستئناف المفاوضات برعاية الآلية الأفريقية خلال أسبوعين. [يحتاج تحقق]
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: Immediately cease all hostilities, including aerial bombardments

december-revolution-transition.quote: ...a close associate of Hemedti after the December 2018 revolution...

december-revolution-transition.en: Constitutional Document signed 17 August 2019 (UNSC2524 p.1, preamble)
december-revolution-transition.ar: توقيع الوثيقة الدستورية 17 أغسطس 2019 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC2524 p.1, preamble)
december-revolution-transition.quote: Welcoming the signing of the Constitutional Document on 17 August 2019

december-revolution-transition.en: UNITAMS created by UNSC res. 2524, 3 June 2020 (UNSC2524 p.1 header; p.3 op. para 1)
december-revolution-transition.ar: إنشاء بعثة يونيتامس بقرار مجلس الأمن 2524، 3 يونيو 2020 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC2524 p.1 header; p.3 op. para 1)
december-revolution-transition.quote: Adopted by the Security Council on 3 June 2020 ... 1. Decides to establish a United Nations Integrated Transition Assistance [Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS)]

cite_extra.note: source era_events.json has date 2524 (resolution number); corrected to 2020

december-revolution-transition.en: Juba Peace Agreement signed 3 October 2020 (Government, SRF, SLM-MM) (UNSC2559 p.2, preamble)
december-revolution-transition.ar: توقيع اتفاق جوبا للسلام في 3 أكتوبر 2020 (الحكومة، الجبهة الثورية، حركة تحرير السودان-مني مناوي) [يحتاج تحقق]
december-revolution-transition.quote: Welcoming the signing of the Juba Peace Agreement in Juba on 3 October 2020 by the Government of Sudan, the Sudan Revolutionary Front and the Sudan Liberation Movement-Minni Minawi

december-revolution-transition.en: Resolution 2559 ended the mandate of the AU-UN hybrid operation in Darfur (UNAMID) as of 31 December 2020. Withdrawal of its personnel was to be completed by 30 June 2021. (UNSC2559 PDF p.2, op.1-2)
december-revolution-transition.ar: أنهى القرار 2559 ولاية العملية المختلطة في دارفور (يوناميد) اعتباراً من 31 ديسمبر 2020، على أن يكتمل الانسحاب بحلول 30 يونيو 2021. [يحتاج تحقق]
december-revolution-transition.quote: Decides to terminate the mandate of UNAMID as of 31 December 2020

december-revolution-transition.en: On 21 February 2021 the Central Bank of Sudan instructed banks to unify the official and parallel exchange rates. Al Jazeera reported the step was expected to sharply devalue the Sudanese pound. (AJA_FLOAT2021 web article (Arabic))
december-revolution-transition.ar: في 21 فبراير 2021 وجّه بنك السودان المركزي المصارف بتوحيد سعري الصرف الرسمي والموازي. [يحتاج تحقق]
december-revolution-transition.quote: قال بنك السودان المركزي -في بيان- إنه أصدر تعليمات للبنوك لتوحيد سعر الصرف الرسمي والموازي اعتبارا من اليوم الأحد، في خطوة من المتوقع أن تؤدي إلى خفض كبير في قيمة الجنيه السوداني

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: Fighting between SAF and RSF starts 15 April 2023 in Khartoum (REPORTED) (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.5, para 4)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: اندلاع القتال بين القوات المسلحة والدعم السريع في الخرطوم 15 أبريل 2023 (مُبلَّغ عنه) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.5, para 4)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: The conflict that started on 15 April in Khartoum between SAF and RSF spread to Darfur by the end of that month.

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: Jeddah Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan, 11 May 2023 (REPORTED) (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.37, para 133)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: إعلان جدة للالتزام بحماية المدنيين 11 مايو 2023 (مُبلَّغ عنه) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.37, para 133)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: On 11 May, the parties signed the Jeddah Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan, in which they made a commitment to allow for humanitarian access and respect international humanitarian law.

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: The UN Panel of Experts records that the Wali of West Darfur, Khamis Abakar, was killed in El Geneina on 14 June 2023. On 19 June RSF and allied militias took over El Geneina. (GEO-001 PDF p.6, table 1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: يسجل فريق خبراء الأمم المتحدة مقتل والي غرب دارفور خميس أبكر في الجنينة في 14 يونيو 2023، وسيطرة الدعم السريع وميليشيات متحالفة على المدينة في 19 يونيو. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: 19 June RSF and allied militias took over El Geneina

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: The Panel of Experts records that the RSF took over the SAF 16th Division in Nyala on 26 October 2023, after attacking it from 21 October. Jeddah talks resumed the same day. (GEO-001 PDF p.6, table 1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: يسجل فريق الخبراء سيطرة الدعم السريع على الفرقة 16 في نيالا في 26 أكتوبر 2023، وهو يوم استئناف محادثات جدة. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: 26 October Resumption of the Jeddah talks RSF took over SAF 16th Division in Nyala

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: The Panel of Experts records the RSF takeover of the SAF 21st Division in Zalingei on 31 October 2023. Days later it attacked Ardamatta and took the SAF 15th Division there. (GEO-001 PDF p.6, table 1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: يسجل فريق الخبراء سيطرة الدعم السريع على الفرقة 21 في زالنجي في 31 أكتوبر 2023، ثم على الفرقة 15 في أردمتا. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: 31 October RSF took over SAF 21st Division in Zalingei

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: Civil society and armed-group signatories of the Juba Agreement met in Addis Ababa in late October 2023. The Panel of Experts records the creation there of the Taqaddum civilian coalition led by former Prime Minister Abdallah Hamdok. (GEO-001 PDF p.6, table 1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: يسجل فريق الخبراء تأسيس تنسيقية 'تقدم' المدنية بقيادة رئيس الوزراء السابق عبد الله حمدوك في أديس أبابا أواخر أكتوبر 2023. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: Creation of Taqaddum civilian coalition led by the former Prime Minister, Abdallah Hamdok

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: On 4 November 2023 the parties signed a new Jeddah commitment reaffirming the 11 May Jeddah Declaration. They agreed among other things to join a humanitarian forum to guarantee access. (GEO-001 PDF p.6, table 1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: في 4 نوفمبر 2023 وقّع الطرفان التزاماً جديداً في جدة يؤكد إعلان 11 مايو. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: 4 November New Jeddah commitment was signed.

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: On 24 December 2024 FAO, WFP and UNICEF reported that famine had been identified in at least five areas: Zamzam, Abu Shouk and Al Salam camps in North Darfur and the Western Nuba Mountains. The report flagged risk of famine in 17 more areas. (WFP_DEC2024 news release)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: في 24 ديسمبر 2024 أفادت الفاو وبرنامج الأغذية العالمي واليونيسف بتحديد المجاعة في خمس مناطق على الأقل، منها مخيمات زمزم وأبو شوك والسلام وغرب جبال النوبة. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: identify famine with reliable data in at least five areas of Sudan – Zamzam, Abu Shouk and Al Salam camps in North Darfur, and in the Western Nuba Mountains for both residents and internally displaced persons (IDPs).

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: An IPC Alert of 12 October 2026 warned of rapidly worsening conditions across Greater Darfur and Kordofan. It said conflict, displacement and drought were driving an increased risk of famine. (IPC_ALERT_OCT2026 p.1)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: حذّر تنبيه للتصنيف المتكامل في 12 أكتوبر 2026 من تدهور سريع في دارفور الكبرى وكردفان، مع تزايد خطر المجاعة بسبب النزاع والنزوح والجفاف. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: Conflict, displacement and drought are driving an increased risk of Famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan.

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: IOM's DTM snapshot of 18 October 2026 recorded an estimated 8,585,611 internally displaced persons across all 18 states. It said the number had fallen 26 per cent from its recorded peak. (IOM_DTM_SNAP10 web page, Main Findings)
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.ar: سجلت لقطة مصفوفة تتبع النزوح في 18 أكتوبر 2026 نحو 8,585,611 نازحاً داخلياً في الولايات الثماني عشرة. [يحتاج تحقق]
war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.quote: An estimated 8,585,611 internally displaced persons (IDPs) were recorded across all 18 states.

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: Second Civil War 1983–2005: SPLA formed 1983; CPA signed 9 January 2005 (HRW1993_CIVDEV Glossary)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.quote: Anya-Nya II rebel south Sudanese forces who, together with former members of the Sudanese army, formed the SPLA in 1983

cite_extra.quote: Welcoming the signing of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement ... in Nairobi, Kenya on 9 January 2005,

cite_extra_2.quote: The Comprehensive Peace Agreement marks the end of two decades of civil war

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: Referendum on self-determination for Southern Sudan, 9 January 2011 (UNSG_S2011_413 PDF p.2, para 4)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: استفتاء تقرير المصير لجنوب السودان 9 يناير 2011 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSG_S2011_413 PDF p.2, para 4)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.quote: On 9 January 2011, voting took place in the referendum on self-determination for Southern Sudan.

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Independence 9 July 2011; UNMISS created by UNSC res. 1996 (8 Jul 2011) (UNSC1996 p.1 preamble; p.3 op. para 1)
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: الاستقلال 9 يوليو 2011؛ إنشاء بعثة أونميس بالقرار 1996 (8 يوليو 2011) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC1996 p.1 preamble; p.3 op. para 1)
republic-of-south-sudan.quote: Welcoming the establishment of the Republic of South Sudan on 9 July 2011 ... 1. Decides to establish as of 9 July 2011 the United Nations Mission in the Republic of South Sudan

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Civil war from 15 December 2013 (CONTESTED) (UNMISS_HRR2014 PDF p.10, para 1)
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: الحرب الأهلية منذ 15 ديسمبر 2013 (متنازع عليه) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNMISS_HRR2014 PDF p.10, para 1)
republic-of-south-sudan.quote: On 15 December 2013, an internal power struggle within the Sudan People’s Liberation [Movement ...]

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Revitalised Agreement on the Resolution of the Conflict in South Sudan (R-ARCSS), 2018 (UNSC2459 p.1, preamble)
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: الاتفاق المنشط لحل النزاع في جنوب السودان 2018 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC2459 p.1, preamble)
republic-of-south-sudan.quote: Underlining that the 2018 “Revitalised Agreement on the Resolution of the Conflict in the Republic of South Sudan” (the Revitalised Agreement) is an important...

ottoman-hejaz-saudi-state.en: Jeddah talks on Sudan war, from May 2023 (REPORTED) (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.37, para 133)
ottoman-hejaz-saudi-state.ar: محادثات جدة بشأن حرب السودان منذ مايو 2023 (مُبلَّغ عنه) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNPOE_S2024_65 PDF p.37, para 133)
ottoman-hejaz-saudi-state.quote: Early in May, talks on a ceasefire and humanitarian assistance started in Jeddah, under the auspices of authorities from Saudi Arabia and the United States.

cite_extra.pages: para 76 (p.25); para 80 (pp.26-27): format 'adopted in Jeddah', Saudi co-organiser

abboud-military-regime.en: Coup November 1958 (General Ibrahim Abbud) (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 44)
abboud-military-regime.ar: انقلاب نوفمبر 1958 (الفريق إبراهيم عبود) [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 44)
abboud-military-regime.quote: After two years of democratic governance following independence in 1956, General Ibrahim Abbud came to power through a coup in November 1958.

abboud-military-regime.en: October Revolution 1964 ends Abboud rule (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 44; LOC1991_CIVIL6469)
abboud-military-regime.ar: ثورة أكتوبر 1964 تنهي حكم عبود [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 44; LOC1991_CIVIL6469)
abboud-military-regime.quote: ...in 1964 student protests in Khartoum led to general public disorder, which soon spread. Abbud resigned as Head of State and a transitional Government was appointed to serve under the provisional Constitution of 1956.

cite_extra.pages: web page 'Return to Civilian Rule, 1964-69' (https://countrystudies.us/sudan/22.htm), para 1 (no page numbers)
cite_extra.quote: The so-called October Revolution of 1964 centered around a general strike that spread throughout the country.

abboud-military-regime.en: Abbud created the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces to rule Sudan, removing decision making from civilian politicians. The council included officers affiliated with both the Ansar and the Khatmiyyah. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: أنشأ عبود المجلس الأعلى للقوات المسلحة لحكم السودان، وضم ضباطاً من الأنصار والختمية. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: Abbud created the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces to rule Sudan.

abboud-military-regime.en: The regime profited from settling the Nile waters dispute with Egypt and improving relations between the two countries. It also marketed the cotton crop successfully in its first year. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: استفاد النظام من تسوية نزاع مياه النيل مع مصر وتحسن العلاقات بين البلدين، ومن تسويق محصول القطن بنجاح في عامه الأول. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: Abbud also profited from the settlement of the Nile waters dispute with Egypt and the improvement of relations between the two countries.

abboud-military-regime.en: In 1959 dissident officers made three attempts to topple the Abbud government. Their leaders were sentenced to life imprisonment, and the Sudanese Communist Party, which backed the attempts, gained a reputation as an effective opposition. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: في 1959 قام ضباط منشقون بثلاث محاولات لإسقاط حكومة عبود، وحُكم على قادتها بالسجن المؤبد. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: In 1959 dissident military officers made three attempts to displace the Abbud government and to establish a "popular government."

abboud-military-regime.en: Abd al Wahab was removed in March 1959; until then the Ansar were the stronger group in the government. Ansar leader Abd ar Rahman al Mahdi died in early 1959. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: أُبعد عبد الوهاب في مارس 1959، وتوفي زعيم الأنصار عبد الرحمن المهدي مطلع العام نفسه. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: Until Abd al Wahab's removal in March 1959, the Ansar were the stronger of the two groups in the government.

abboud-military-regime.en: Southern leaders renewed the armed struggle against the government in 1963. The rebellion was spearheaded by guerrilla forces known as the Anya Nya. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: جدد قادة الجنوب الكفاح المسلح ضد الحكومة عام 1963 بقيادة قوات الأنيانيا. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: The rebellion was spearheaded from 1963 by guerrilla forces known as the Anya Nya

abboud-military-regime.en: In February 1964 Abbud ordered the mass expulsion of foreign missionaries from the south. He then closed parliament, cutting off outlets for southern complaints. (LOC1991_ABBUD HTML page, no page numbers)
abboud-military-regime.ar: في فبراير 1964 أمر عبود بطرد جماعي للمبشرين الأجانب من الجنوب، ثم أغلق البرلمان. [يحتاج تحقق]
abboud-military-regime.quote: In February 1964, for example, Abbud ordered the mass explusion of foreign missionaries from the south.

second-parliamentary-period.en: Elections 1965; Mahjub coalition government; armed rebellion in the south since 1963 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, paras 44-45)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: انتخابات 1965 وحكومة محجوب الائتلافية؛ تمرد مسلح في الجنوب منذ 1963 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, paras 44-45)
second-parliamentary-period.quote: ...in 1963 an armed rebellion emerged. ... The transitional Government held elections in April and May 1965. A coalition Government headed by a leading politician of the Umma party, Mohmmed Ahmed Mahjub, was formed in June 1965.

second-parliamentary-period.en: After the October Revolution, Sirr al Khatim al Khalifa, a nonpolitical senior civil servant, was chosen to head a transitional government. It operated under the 1956 Transitional Constitution. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: بعد ثورة أكتوبر اختير سر الختم الخليفة، وهو موظف كبير غير حزبي، لرئاسة حكومة انتقالية عملت بدستور 1956 الانتقالي. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: selected a nonpolitical senior civil servant, Sirr al Khatim al Khalifa, as prime minister to head a transitional government.

second-parliamentary-period.en: The 1965 elections were inconclusive; the Umma won 75 of 158 seats and the NUP 52. The two formed a coalition in June under Muhammad Ahmad Mahjub, with Azhari as permanent president of the Supreme Commission. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: جاءت انتخابات 1965 غير حاسمة؛ ففاز حزب الأمة بـ75 مقعداً من 158 والوطني الاتحادي بـ52، وشكّلا ائتلافاً برئاسة محمد أحمد محجوب. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: The Umma captured 75 out of 158 parliamentary seats while its NUP ally took 52 of the remainder.

second-parliamentary-period.en: The army launched a major offensive against the southern rebellion. Many southerners reported atrocities against civilians, especially at Juba and Waw, and troops burned churches and huts and destroyed crops and cattle. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: شن الجيش هجوماً كبيراً على التمرد الجنوبي، وأفاد جنوبيون كثيرون بفظائع ضد المدنيين لا سيما في جوبا وواو. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: Many southerners reported government atrocities against civilians, especially at Juba and Waw.

second-parliamentary-period.en: Mahjub had parliament approve a decree abolishing the Sudanese Communist Party and unseating its eleven members. Sadiq al Mahdi later refused to honour a Supreme Court ruling overturning the ban. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: أقر البرلمان بطلب من محجوب مرسوماً بحل الحزب الشيوعي السوداني وإسقاط عضوية نوابه الأحد عشر. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: Mahjub succeeded in having parliament approve a decree that abolished the SCP and deprived the eleven communists of their seats.

second-parliamentary-period.en: Mahjub resigned in July 1966 after a vote of censure that split the Umma. Sadiq al Mahdi became prime minister with backing from his Umma wing and NUP allies. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: استقال محجوب في يوليو 1966 بعد اقتراع بحجب الثقة شق حزب الأمة، وتولى الصادق المهدي رئاسة الوزراء. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: resigned in July 1966 after a parliamentary vote of censure, which resulted in a split in the Umma.

second-parliamentary-period.en: In December 1966 a coup attempt by communists and a small army unit failed. The government then arrested many communists and army personnel. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: في ديسمبر 1966 فشلت محاولة انقلاب نفذها شيوعيون ووحدة عسكرية صغيرة. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: In December 1966, a coup attempt by communists and a small army unit against the government failed.

second-parliamentary-period.en: In December 1967 the PDP and the NUP merged to form the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) under Azhari. Mahjub had returned as prime minister in May 1967. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: في ديسمبر 1967 اندمج حزب الشعب الديمقراطي والوطني الاتحادي في الحزب الاتحادي الديمقراطي بقيادة الأزهري. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: In December 1967, the PDP and the NUP formed the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) under Azhari's leadership.

second-parliamentary-period.en: After a Supreme Court ruling backed Mahjub's dissolution of parliament, elections were held in April 1968. The DUP won 101 of 218 seats but no party held a majority, and Sadiq al Mahdi lost his own seat. (LOC1991_CIVIL6469 HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: بعد أن أيدت المحكمة العليا حل البرلمان أجريت انتخابات أبريل 1968، ففاز الاتحادي الديمقراطي بـ101 من 218 مقعداً دون أغلبية، وخسر الصادق المهدي مقعده. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: Although the DUP won 101 of 218 seats, no single party controlled a parliamentary majority.

second-parliamentary-period.en: By the late 1960s the first southern war had resulted in the deaths of about 500,000 people, according to the Library of Congress study. Several hundred thousand more southerners hid in forests or fled to refugee camps in neighbouring countries. (LOC1991_SOUTH HTML page, no page numbers)
second-parliamentary-period.ar: بحلول أواخر الستينيات أسفرت الحرب الجنوبية الأولى عن مقتل نحو 500 ألف شخص وفق دراسة مكتبة الكونغرس، وفر مئات الآلاف إلى الغابات أو مخيمات اللجوء في الدول المجاورة. [يحتاج تحقق]
second-parliamentary-period.quote: Several hundred thousand more southerners hid in the forests or escaped to refugee camps in neighboring countries.

toll.quote: By the late 1960s, the war had resulted in the deaths of about 500,000 people.
